title: Updating the radius register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $2$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its radius by $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 2 equal to its radius field. Replacing coordinate 2 of this
vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing its
radius field by $y$.
